source_text: ὁμοειδὴς γὰρ τῷ μόσχῳ δάμαλις, ἀλλ' ἐν πολλῇ λίαν
pass_a_gloss: [Cont. of Cyril] …for of the same form/kind (ὁμοειδής) with the calf is the heifer (δάμαλις), but in very much… [continues in §34: '…pre-eminence (ὑπεροχή) are His things']
pass_b_english: Cyril: …(for the heifer is of the same kind as the calf), yet all that is his stands in a very great…

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Cyril, De adoratione Book 10. Translated afresh from the PG 68 Greek on 2026-10-23; the withheld earlier English was not used.

apparatus.note: PG OCR; column may cut mid-sentence.

A one-line fragment between two PG column breaks (68.712–713). It completes the clause begun at the end of §32 ('For even if He became like us') and runs into §34 ('pre-eminence'). The English parenthesis reflects the explanatory γάρ clause; 'yet all that is His stands' takes τὰ αὐτοῦ from §34 so the split falls naturally.

changes: none: clause-by-clause check found the draft faithful (γάρ parenthesis and split of τὰ αὐτοῦ into §33 confirmed)
